slots.name: Snap
slots.why: Three plucked notes with a different colour. The kalimba starts at once and its ring falls 20 dB in 0.15 s. The pizzicato is the short choice (0.36 s). Nobody listened yet.

slots.name: Lift
slots.why: The spec names Bubble Pop for the lift. The two Kenney card slides have a short and sharp attack. Nobody listened yet.

slots.name: Wrong drop
slots.why: The spec names Boing 2 from labrynth2. The Parent heard it in labrynth2.

slots.name: Flip
slots.why: Kenney card sounds with the shortest body (0.13 s to 0.24 s). The game has no flip yet (ticket 06).

slots.name: Deck tap
slots.why: Cards come out of the deck. The fan has a slow start (0.58 s to the peak). The game has no deck yet (ticket 06).

slots.name: Group complete
slots.why: A short ta-da and two chimes. The ta-da has brass, as the level fanfare. The game has no group event yet (ticket 08).

slots.name: Level complete
slots.why: The spec names the labrynth2 fanfare, with the same cut at 3.7 s and the 0.5 s fade-out. The game has no level event yet (ticket 08).

slots.name: Pop (pals with no own sound)
slots.why: A pal with no own sound plays the pop: higher for a small pal, lower for a big pal. The pick is the most downloaded pop on Freesound. Bubble Pop is also the lift sound.

slots.name: Dog
slots.why: Three barks. The pick has the best rating (4.6) and no noise between the barks. The second has the most downloads, so the two are close.

slots.name: Lion
slots.why: Three short roars. The pick has the most downloads. A roar can be too scary for a small child.

slots.name: Pig
slots.why: The pick is a clean oink of 0.7 s, with the most downloads and a 4.7 rating.

slots.name: Horse
slots.why: The pick is a short neigh with ten times the downloads of the other two.

slots.name: Donkey
slots.why: The pick is a short bray. The two field recordings are cut from 10 s files and have village noise.

slots.name: Goat
slots.why: The pick is a clean bleat of 0.9 s with ten times the downloads of the other two.

slots.name: Rooster
slots.why: The pick is a full cock-a-doodle-doo of 2 s with a 4.8 rating and no noise floor.

slots.name: Baby chick
slots.why: Freesound has few CC0 chick peeps. The pick has some noise.

slots.name: Owl
slots.why: Hoot sequences longer than 3 s, so each clip is a 2.5 s cut. The Breviceps owl is very quiet (-41 LUFS) and gets +23 dB.

slots.name: Frog
slots.why: The pick is a clean croak of 0.5 s with the most downloads and a 4.8 rating.

slots.name: Monkey
slots.why: A child knows the 'ooh ooh' of a monkey imitation. The real monkey (Affen schreit) is a scream.

slots.name: Wolf
slots.why: A howl is long, so each clip is a 2.5 s cut. The cut can stop in the middle of a howl.

slots.name: Bird
slots.why: Three bird songs. Nobody listened yet.

slots.name: Goose
slots.why: The pick is one clean honk, but very quiet (-39 LUFS), so it gets +20 dB.

slots.name: Honeybee
slots.why: Three buzzes. The first two have almost the same number of downloads.

slots.name: Cricket
slots.why: The pick is a clean chirp of 1.1 s with the most downloads and a 4.8 rating.

slots.name: Dove
slots.why: A coo is soft. Nobody listened yet.

slots.name: Tiger
slots.why: Three short roars, close to the lion. Roar.m4a is very loud in the source (-5 LUFS).

slots.name: Automobile
slots.why: Three car horns. The second is a 'beep beep' that clips in the source.

slots.name: Locomotive
slots.why: A steam whistle, a 'choo choo', and one steam chuff. The pick has the most downloads.

slots.name: Motorcycle
slots.why: Engine sounds of 4.5 s to 5 s, so each clip is a 2.5 s cut.

slots.name: Airplane
slots.why: Jet sounds. A jet is a slow noise with no clear start.

slots.name: Bicycle
slots.why: Three bicycle bells. The pick (4.9 rating) is cut to 2.5 s.

slots.name: Rocket
slots.why: The pick is a short launch of 1.4 s with the most downloads and a 4.9 rating.

slots.name: Alarm clock
slots.why: Three bell alarm clocks. A ring can be too loud and sharp for a small child.

slots.name: Bell
slots.why: Three bells. Nobody listened yet.

slots.name: Drum
slots.why: Three snare drum rolls. The pick is the shortest (1.7 s).

slots.name: Guitar
slots.why: One chord, a strum, and a short phrase. Nobody listened yet.

slots.name: Trumpet
slots.why: Three single trumpet notes. Nobody listened yet.

slots.name: Violin
slots.why: A bowed note (cut to 2.5 s), a short spiccato note, and a sharp phrase.

slots.name: Maracas
slots.why: Three maraca shakes. The pick is quiet in the source (-36 LUFS).

slots.name: Cloud with lightning
slots.why: Three thunder claps. Thunder can scare a small child.
